ken: spinning up a focused sanity run for sundial-int6 vs conch-emb-512.fp16 on product_holdout_40k. CI: https://ci.internal/9201
maria: what config? batch/seq/seed/normalize?
ken: batch=128, seq=192, seed=9001, L2-normalize before quant. metrics: recall@1/10/100, jaccard_top10, silhouette, pca32_var.
sam: first-pass results?
ci-bot: job 9201 finished \u2014 FAILED (recall regression > 2%). baseline recall@10=0.827, sundial-int6=0.792. recall@1 baseline=0.615 -> sundial=0.559.
maria: any stratification by query length?
ken: yes  short (<6 tokens) recall@1 down ~6.8%, mid (6-24) down ~3.4%, long (>24) ~0.9%. L2 norm mean drops ~7% post-quant.
sam: can you paste 3 short-query id-flips for quick inspection?
ken: 1) "install docker" baseline top1 doc#412 (install steps) sim=0.91, sundial top1 doc#789 (docker internals) sim=0.66
2) "oauth refresh token" baseline top1 doc#1201 (refresh flow) sim=0.88, sundial top1 doc#3210 (jwt rotate) sim=0.60
3) "merge branches" baseline top1 doc#23 (merge vs rebase) sim=0.86, sundial top1 doc#88 (stash/merge) sim=0.63
maria: looks like confidence collapse on short queries. hypotheses: per-dim clipping, asymmetric channel scales, or spectral energy loss in top components. try percentile clip and affine calib.
ken: launching three follow-ups: 9202 (perc-clip int6, q=0.999), 9203 (per-channel affine calibration, small-vec learn), 9204 (distill-lite teacher=conch fp16 -> student sundial-int6 on 300k pairs). links: https://ci.internal/9202 https://ci.internal/9203 https://ci.internal/9204
sam: include jaccard(top10) vs baseline broken down by length buckets and label if available. save top-50 id-flips. also PCA variance first 32 comps.
ken: will collect per-length recall curves, jaccard histograms, PCA var plot, and sample id-flips. estimated runtime ~2-3 hours. will post results + small repro notebook.
alex: if 9204 needs priority ping me, can bump GPU queue.
ci-bot: jobs 9202-9204 queued. ETA 9202:1h20m, 9203:1h50m, 9204:3h10m.
